# fleet-public-relations-mcp

Private MCP server for fleet PR outreach.
- [README.md](README.md) — full docs
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — complete tool + API + skills reference
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) — setup

## Tools
- `register_thread(url, repo_id)` — start monitoring a thread
- `get_active_threads()` — list monitored URLs
- `scan_threads_now()` — force scraper + evaluator run
- `get_pr_dashboard()` — feedback summary stats
- `show_pr_dashboard_card()` — Prefab UI card
- `fleet_pr_help()` — help and usage
- `fleet_pr_shutdown()` — graceful shutdown

## Config
See `.env.example` for all env vars. LLM evaluator uses `FLEET_PR_SAMPLING_BASE_URL` (defaults to Ollama on localhost:11434).
## Ports
Backend: 11094 | Frontend: 11095
